name: GitLab
description: Reads your GitLab merge requests, their comments and your branches into Zeff — through GitLab in the account's automation Chrome. Replies, merges, opened merge requests and resolved threads go through the same scraper. Its scraper is a lambda you (or the AI) can mend when GitLab changes. (Connected through GitLab's API with a token or sign-in? That reading is still Zeff's — switch only when it is the automation Chrome.)
author: Zeff
